public struct Animal: Codable {
    public var name: String

    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case name = "name"
    }
}

public struct Dog: Codable {
    public var name: String
    public var breed: String

    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {
        case name = "name"
        case breed = "breed"
    }
}
